name: media-playlist
title: Media playlist
description: Tracks or videos for your own player: a now-playing row with an animated equaliser, durations, an Up next heading and arrow-key browsing.
docs: Pass items ({ id, title, subtitle?, duration, artwork? }, duration in seconds), currentId, playing and onSelect(id). It is presentation only: you own the player, it owns the list. The current row is tinted, carries aria-current and says "Now playing" or "Paused" to a screen reader; four bars replace its number, move only while playing is true, rest at different heights when paused and stay still under reduced motion. Other rows show a play mark on hover and focus. Tab enters the list once, on the current item; the arrow keys, Home and End walk it; Enter calls onSelect, also for the current item (read it as play or pause). A cut title shows whole in a tooltip on hover and focus. showUpNext adds an "Up next" heading after the current item, kind="video" draws 16:9 thumbnails, title adds a header with count and total length, maxHeight sets where it scrolls, locale and labels translate. The list answers to its own width: below 24rem the numbers leave the rows (the current row shows its bars on its picture), pictures shrink and titles wrap to two lines (three below 20rem) instead of being cut to a few words; a video list always wraps to two.
